new_scholarship.description: The Invest Your Talent in Italy programme, run by the Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation together with the ICE Agency and Uni-Italia, awards scholarships to international students from 23 listed countries to attend a Master's degree or postgraduate programme at an Italian university participating in the programme. The scholarship is worth EUR 10,800 for nine months starting 1 October 2026 and includes exemption from tuition fees. Recipients must complete a compulsory internship at an Italian company or professional association consistent with their field of study. Only courses in Engineering and Advanced Technologies, Management and Economics, and Design and Architecture listed in the programme catalogue are eligible, and candidates must first obtain pre-admission from the university.

new_scholarship.official_source: Alma Mater Studiorum – Università di Bologna
new_scholarship.program_type: University merit and needs-based study grant for international students matriculating in a Second Cycle (Master's) degree programme
new_scholarship.description: The University of Bologna awards 30 International Talents @unibo study grants each year to international students who matriculate for the first time in the first year of a Second Cycle (Laurea Magistrale) degree programme. Each grant is worth EUR 6,500 gross per academic year and is awarded for two academic years, and successful applicants also receive a full tuition fee waiver, paying only EUR 157.04 in regional taxes, stamp duty and insurance premium. Selection is based on GRE General Test scores, with minimum scores of 290 in the combined Verbal and Quantitative Reasoning sections and 3.0 in Analytical Writing, together with a family economic situation within an ISEE band of EUR 16,000 to EUR 35,000. Applicants must be under 30 years old at the deadline and must not already be a student of the University of Bologna.

Winners must send an unconditional acceptance declaration to internationaldesk@unibo.it within 10 days of the award notification.

new_scholarship.description: Politecnico di Milano runs an annual merit-based scholarship scheme for international candidates applying to the first year of an English-taught Master of Science programme. The 2027/2028 call offers 64 awards: 10 Platinum (Milan), 18 Gold (Milan), 16 Gold Piacenza Campus, 10 Bronze Piacenza Campus and 10 Silver scholarships for the Cremona, Lecco, Mantova and Piacenza campuses. Every award includes a full tuition-fee waiver for the academic year, and the cash tiers add a gross allowance of EUR 10,000 (Platinum), EUR 8,000 (Gold), EUR 5,000 (Gold Piacenza) or EUR 2,500 (Bronze); the Silver tier is a waiver only. Recipients must pay a non-refundable administrative fee of about EUR 170 on acceptance, and the awards can be renewed for a second year on academic points.

alerts.message: The University states scholarships are limited and based on the admission score, and that you do not need to apply separately. Missing your programme's admission deadline loses the scholarship automatically.
Female students enrolled in STEM programmes receive EUR 8,500 per year instead of EUR 7,200.

The May instalment requires at least 50% of the course credits in the January and February sessions; failing that, you can still be paid in October if you have 42 ECTS (36 on Italian-taught courses) by 10 August.

In September the University checks credits earned by 10 August. If you fall short you must return part of the scholarship and pay the following year's tuition fees, which range from EUR 1,000 to EUR 10,000 depending on credits and fee band.

submission_workflow: Choose a degree programme and open its 'Admission and enrollment for non-Europeans' page on corsi.unitn.it
Read the call for admission for the relevant academic year
Prepare the required academic documents
Submit the application and pay the EUR 30.00 fee before the deadline
Sit the selection or assessment the programme requires
Await the ranking list, which shows admission and scholarship assignation together
Accept and complete enrolment by the communicated deadline
Earn at least half the required credits in the January and February exam sessions
Receive the first instalment by December and the second by May of the first year
Check your credit total by 10 August each year to keep the award

research_notes.logo: unitn.it blocks plain HTTP clients: webfetch returned HTTP 403 for both the stored scholarship page and the logo assets, and Playwright timed out on the first navigation. Rendering the page in the browser produced the full official text and a usable markup scan. The scan surfaced two candidate marks: /themes/custom/unitn_default/logo.svg (alt "Home") and /themes/custom/unitn_eventi/logointerno.svg (alt "logo universita trento"). Probing both by navigating to them in the browser showed the main logo.svg is the white variant, carrying <title>logo white</title> and only a #FFFFFF fill, which the brief bans, so it was rejected. logointerno.svg returned HTTP 200 with content-type image/svg+xml and contains near-black #231F20 and Trento red #CF1F38 fills, so it is the correct dark mark and was reported. Both assets sit on the awarding body's own domain unitn.it.
